caption: The worked example at a glance: with α = 1/√2 and β = i/√2 the modulus squares are 0.5 and 0.5, so measurement gives 0 or 1 with equal probability. Only one branch happens, and the state becomes that branch alone — outcome 0 leaves |0⟩, outcome 1 leaves |1⟩.

spec.aria: One qubit state with amplitudes 1/√2 and i/√2 splits into two measurement branches, outcome 0 with probability 0.5 collapsing to |0⟩ and outcome 1 with probability 0.5 collapsing to |1⟩.
